description: Source code for an ATM driver core functions for the AR9 chipset, including hardware initialization, firmware management, and control operations.

methods.name: init_pmu
methods.description: Initializes the Power Management Unit by enabling specific modules.

methods.name: uninit_pmu
methods.description: Placeholder for uninitializing the PMU (empty implementation).

methods.name: reset_ppe
methods.description: Resets the PPE component, conditionally compiled.

methods.name: init_ema
methods.description: Initializes the EMA buffers and configuration registers.

methods.name: pp32_download_code
methods.description: Downloads firmware code and data to the PP32 processor.

methods.name: ar9_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version (major and minor).

methods.name: ar9_init
methods.description: Performs hardware initialization for AR9 ATM driver.

methods.name: ar9_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the AR9 ATM hardware modules.

methods.name: ar9_start
methods.description: Starts the firmware execution on the PP32 processor.

methods.name: ar9_stop
methods.description: Stops the firmware execution on the PP32 processor.
